links.outcome: External rater documentation quality (PDQI-9) of AI-generated versus manual preanesthetic reports
links.effect: External raters judged documentation quality higher for manual reports (+4 PDQI-9 points; p = 0.004); clinicians less confident in AI-generated formatting.
links.quote: However, external raters judged documentation quality to be higher for manual reports (+4 PDQI-9 points; p = 0.004), and clinicians expressed less confidence in AI-generated formatting.

screen.reason: Randomized simulation trial evaluating the effect of using an LLM-based documentation tool versus manual documentation during simulated preanesthetic consultations.
